lines: 天道图书馆最新章节_完本感言以及新书计划第1页_天道图书馆横扫天涯_热点小说网
> 完本感言以及新书计划（第1页）
昨天就想写个完本感言，结果，来了个朋友，一直没空，拖到了现在。
这本书，给了我太多的荣誉，大神、白金，海外第一……
但也是写作这么多年来，最艰难的。
经历了大喜，有了儿子，也经历了大悲，父亲去世。
曾觉得自己可掌控世界，无所不能；
也曾感到现实一无是处，是个废物！
情感起伏，书中，难免会夹杂一些在内，没想象中的圆满。
现在就说一处大纲设计好，却没写出来的。
洛七七，大纲设计，上苍的时候，为了救张悬死亡，化为静空珠，进入神界。
张悬情绪暴怒之下，练成九幽神瞳，毁天灭地，但他也因此失明……
伏笔早就埋好了，结果，因为洛七七和洛若曦的反转，不敢写了。
我也为自己的任性付出了足够的代价，汗！
没办法，只好改大纲，不敢虐主……
有人说，结尾的匆忙，其实一点都不匆忙。
在最高潮的时候结尾，张悬最绚烂的时刻结束，是最好的选择，如果继续写下去，就有些拖沓了。
悬悬，最喜欢装逼，你让他不装逼的活着，还不如让他死了……
所以……完本了！（怎么样，这个解释满意不？这已经是我想的最好理由了。实在不满意，过来打我啊！我虽然打不过，但我有傲气，绝对跪出一个超帅的姿势……）
不过，大家不要着急，最近老涯有空就会写番外，例如：洛玄青番外。。伏笔布置了，为啥最后没提，因为，老涯要单独给他写个番外，说实话，我也很想知道，他听到张悬成为帝君后的表情……
至于洛七七的结果，老涯也在考虑，会给个结果，具体如何，也会补在番外上。
番外，会发在公众号上，大家可以微信搜索“横扫天涯”，添加关注，一旦更新，就会提醒。
新书老涯有了两个构思，正在纠结要写哪一个。
至于类型，还是玄幻，异世大陆，和天道图书馆一样，轻松幽默，而且保证绝地创新，让你想不到……我粗略的扫了一遍，和起点所有类型的书，都不一样，绝对没人写过。
至于啥时候发布，容我休息一段时间，这一本书，感觉将精力全部榨干了，我需要休息，也需要充电。
不过，不会拖太久，元旦前，应该会开。
至于哪天，书名叫什么，我会在公众号和微博上提前公布（新浪微博，搜索“起点横扫天涯”有认证的就是）。
【看书领红包】关注公..众号【书友大本营】，看书抽最高888现金红包！
好了，多的不说了，有相聚就有分别，天道的故事，我知道有很多的缺陷，但，我真的是认真在写，我对张悬的感情，超过任何人。
写“全书完”三个字的时候，已经凌晨四点，我静静的坐在凳子上，发呆了接近一个小时。
不过，后面，会有新的故事，一个崭新的世界，同样向大家展开。
一个不同于张悬，不同于聂云的故事。
喜欢老涯的，请收藏一下本书，新书，不出意外，两个月内，会有消息……
最后，祝看我书的所有人，全部……666。

The latest chapter of Library of Tiandao_Complete Remarks and New Book Plan Page 1_Library of Tiandao Sweeps the End of the World_Hot Novel Network
> Final remarks and new book plan (page 1)
Yesterday I wanted to write a reflection on the completion of this book, but a friend came over and never got around to it, so I put it off until now.
This book has given me so many honors, including being a master, platinum gold medalist, and number one overseas...
But it is also the most difficult thing for so many years of writing.
I experienced great joy, having a son, and also experienced great tragedy, when my father passed away.
I once felt that I could control the world and be omnipotent;
I also felt that reality was worthless and a waste!
There are inevitably some emotional ups and downs in the book, which are not as complete as imagined.
Now let’s talk about an outline that was designed but not written.
Luo Qiqi, in the outline design, died in order to save Zhang Xuan, turned into a static sky bead, and entered the divine world.
In a fit of rage, Zhang Xuan cultivated the Nine Nether Divine Eyes and destroyed the world, but he also became blind because of it...
The foreshadowing had been laid for a long time, but because of the reversal between Luo Qiqi and Luo Ruoxi, I didn't dare to write it.
I also paid a sufficient price for my willfulness, sweat!
I have no choice but to change the outline, not daring to abuse the host...
Some people say that the ending is rushed, but it is not rushed at all.
Ending at the climax, Zhang Xuan's most glorious moment, is the best choice. If you continue writing, it will be a bit delayed.
Xuanxuan likes to show off the most. If you let him live without showing off, it would be better to let him die...
So... the book is finished! (So, are you satisfied with this explanation? This is the best reason I can think of. If you are really dissatisfied, come and beat me! Although I can’t beat me, I am arrogant and will definitely kneel down in a super handsome posture...)
However, don't worry, Lao Ya will write extras when he has time recently, such as: Luo Xuanqing's extras. . The foreshadowing was laid out, but why I didn’t mention it at the end was because Lao Ya wanted to write a separate side story for him. To be honest, I also wanted to know his expression after hearing that Zhang Xuan became the emperor...
As for the outcome of Luo Qiqi, Lao Ya is also considering it and will give a result. The details will be added in the extra chapter.
Extras will be posted on the public account. You can search "Sweeping the World" on WeChat and add followers. Once updated, you will be reminded.
Lao Ya has two ideas for a new book and is debating which one to write.
As for the genre, it is still fantasy, a different world, just like the Library of Tiandao, it is light-hearted and humorous, and it is guaranteed to be innovative and make you think... I scanned it roughly, and it is different from all the other types of books in Qidian. It has definitely not been written by anyone.
As for when it will be released, let me rest for a while. This book feels like it has drained all my energy. I need to rest and recharge.
However, it won’t take too long, and it should be open before New Year’s Day.
As for the date and the title of the book, I will announce it in advance on the official account and Weibo (Sina Weibo, search for "Starting Point Sweeps the End of the World" to get the certification).
[Get red envelopes by reading books] Follow the public account [Book Friends Base Camp] and get up to 888 cash red envelopes by reading books!
Okay, I won’t say much more. When we meet, we are separated. I know there are many flaws in the story of Tiandao, but I really wrote it seriously. My feelings for Zhang Xuan are more than anyone else’s.
When I wrote the three words "completed the book", it was already four o'clock in the morning. I sat quietly on the stool and was in a daze for nearly an hour.
However, later on, there will be a new story and a brand new world that will also unfold for everyone.
A story different from Zhang Xuan and Nie Yun.
If you like Lao Ya, please save this book. It’s a new book. If nothing unexpected happens, there will be news within two months...
Finally, I wish everyone who reads my book, all...666.
